faultSchedule: ready while first snapshot is deferred
offline then online before reconnect ready
remove/full clear and batch during reconnect snapshot, followed by post-clear snapshot
long background crossing Shanghai midnight then foreground
workspace switch then stale previous-socket event
boundaries: Actual apiClient, repository, WebSocket decoder, sync hook, journal, tombstones and store execute in an isolated jsdom context.
Fetch, WebSocket transport and native recovery signals are controlled fixtures; no real server, database, Android, browser paint or network fault is measured.
Five trials preserve raw stage samples and explicitly scoped functional-stage means. This is not a device latency baseline or the computation benchmark protocol.
Node sourceProvenance records the collection checkout independently of optional browser build injection; no clean-release provenance is claimed when dirty or unavailable.
Only one singleton client exists per trial. Two/three concurrent clients require separate browser contexts and remain unverified.
Business/lifecycle Date is injected around Shanghai midnight; durations use the real local monotonic clock.

environment.unavailableReason: Device model and Android/WebView versions require native device metadata or external inspection; userAgent is retained without version inference.

reactProfiler.reason: Requires a dedicated React profiling build

boundaries: Durations use one local monotonic clock; overlapping stages must not be added.
State completion and React commit/render do not prove pixels have been presented.
Commit approximations use the first subsequent orders-subtree Profiler commit, which may include unrelated changes; target state presentation and businessFeedbackMs are unavailable.
react_render startMs is callback receipt time and actualDuration is React-reported work; concurrent render may not occupy a contiguous wall-clock interval.
sync_receive_to_state starts at the decoded-event hook callback; realtime_decode is separate and both exclude earlier network queueing.
Handler stages exclude input queueing before callback entry.
Interaction grouping is bounded by the retained sample window; evicted groups may be counted again if reported later.
Event Timing includes reported entries above the configured threshold only; no page INP is calculated.
Scroll intervals are rAF callback intervals during scrolling, not proof of presented frames.
Heap is optional JS heap observation, not Android process memory or proof of a leak.
Recording starts observing future activity only and never initiates business operations.
